title: ExcaScene: decision-centric evaluation of excavator perception under sensor faults (code)
description:
Code for ExcaScene, a paired simulation benchmark that evaluates excavator perception by the decisions it leads to. It contains the scene generator, ray-cast sensor models and paired fault interventions; two perception architectures (KinAfford dynamic and BEVFusion-Exca); the direct and composed point selectors and evaluator; camera-health monitors; classical and fixed reference policies; and the analysis and figure scripts behind the manuscript prepared for Automation in Construction.

Data, checkpoints, per-decision outputs and numerical results: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23723851 (CC BY 4.0 for original ExcaScene material, with retained upstream pretrained-component terms).
